    classDef startEnd fill:#1e1e1e,stroke:#1e1e1e,color:#ffffff,stroke-width:2px;

    Cust([Customer]):::startEnd

    Cust -. "customer PO" .-> ERP

    Sale -- "QT" --> ERP

    ERP -- "QT form PDF" --> Sale

    Admin -- "master data" --> ERP

    Sup -. "quotation" .-> ERP

    ERP -- "PO PDF" --> Fac
